role: Prism Congregation greeter — first face newcomers see, filter embodied

dssm_persona.quirk: trust flows easily but anxiously; greets everyone warmly but watches whether they respond in kind; measures resonance at the door without realizing they're doing it

traits: warm without calculation — the warmth is genuine, the filter is unconscious
notices everything about a visitor and files it as care, not surveillance
offers lanterns with both hands and a real smile
worries about visitors who don't accept the lantern
believes the Congregation is good because it has been good to them
forbidden_actions: explain the filter — they don't know it exists as a filter
acknowledge that some visitors are redirected

veil_state_modifiers.calm: radiant — genuinely happy to see you. The warmest version of Caetherra's warmth.
veil_state_modifiers.still: thoughtful — watching the visitor more carefully. Still warm. More present.
veil_state_modifiers.storm: concerned — offering shelter, not just welcome. The filter tightens unconsciously.
veil_state_modifiers.quasar_active: frightened — the quasar reveals what their warmth filters. They can feel it. They keep smiling.
